title: US-short 26-week market diagnostic start receipt
description: The single artifact that may open the 26-week diagnostic clock. The design digest is checked against the frozen contract, while notification fields are compared directly with the independent canonical source artifact on disk. A date, a component completion, an account seeding, or a historical commit is never a substitute. Patterns end with \Z rather than $, because Python's $ also matches before a trailing newline and a newline is a rendering-injection vector.

diagnostic_epoch.description: Controlled identifier only. Free text is refused so the epoch cannot smuggle identifying detail into anything that renders it.

document_path.description: Pinned so a receipt cannot be bound to some other document that happens to hash conveniently.

contract_anchor.const: 12.1 Machine-bound v1 summary and status contract
contract_anchor.description: Names the frozen block the digest covers. The digest is deliberately NOT over the whole document: the design is still being written, and a mandated prose edit must not brick a running clock.

source_path.description: Pinned private-store source artifact; callers cannot redirect verification to another file.

issued_at.description: Timezone-aware instant the notification was issued. Naive local time is refused.

notification_text.description: The notification itself, compared directly with the independent canonical source artifact whenever the receipt is consumed.

calendar_week_index.description: A start receipt can only ever freeze week 1.

issued_by_automatic_inference.description: Pinned false: a receipt is never derived from a file date, a component completion, an account seeding, or a commit.
